subject.title: feat(memory-wiki): add wiki_open_items tool to list unresolved questions and contradictions

question: Should memory-wiki expose unresolved knowledge-health items through a new `wiki_open_items` tool, or keep `wiki_lint` as the single canonical health API?
rationale: The implementation is sound, but adding a bundled agent-visible tool creates a durable product/API contract that has not been confirmed by a feature owner in the discussion.

options.title: Approve dedicated tool
options.body: Keep `wiki_open_items` as the narrow, clustered, filterable read API distinct from broad linting and report generation.

options.title: Extend wiki_lint
options.body: Preserve one health tool by adding structured filtering and contradiction variants to `wiki_lint`.

options.title: Wait for the consumer
options.body: Defer the primitive until the linked interactive resolution flow defines its exact item identity and write-back requirements.

recommendation.title: Approve dedicated tool
recommendation.body: Keep `wiki_open_items` as the narrow, clustered, filterable read API distinct from broad linting and report generation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history owns the existing lint and claim-health surfaces that this proposed API would sit beside.
